env_context_strategy.note: Benchmark environments (ALFWorld, WebShop, Game24); context is task text plus environment observations.

context_compaction.note: Rollback removes erroneous steps from trajectory, but this is error correction, not compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Obs k+1: You open the drawer 5. The drawer 5 is open. In it

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: We evaluate our framework on three representative agent tasks: Game of 24 (Yao et al., 2023a) for mathematical reasoning, ALFWorld (Shridhar et al., 2020) for embodied house hold tasks, Webshop
edit_primitive.note: Scalar written for list-typed dimension would violate rule; see array.

tool_schema_source.note: Action space described in hand-written prompt files.

protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mention in README, file tree or paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: GA-Rollback utilizes a generator to interact with the environment and an assistant to examine each action produced by the generator, where the assistant triggers a rollback operation upon detection of incorrect actions.
loop_primitives.note: Default act-mode loop with stepwise assistant review and rollback; ReAct mode and Reflexion multi-trial variants (alf_reflexion_rollback.py) also shipped, suggesting multi_attempt reachable via separate scripts.

planning_granularity.note: Planning only via free-text thoughts in react mode; no plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the generator produces actions along the trajectory, while the assistant serves as a rollback controller
multi_agent_topology.note: Generator + assistant (critic) pair; closest value is imperfect—assistant reviews rather than delegates. Could be argued single per C3 reviewer rule.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the assistant will provide detailed feedback to guide the generator in performing rollback operations

human_in_loop.note: Batch benchmark runs; no approval mechanism described.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: we also incorporate past mistakes as experiential knowledge into the prompt to avoid the repetition of similar errors.
long_term_memory.note: Past mistakes stored within a task run only; Reflexion variant carries reflections across trials of same task, not across runs.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the assistant meticulously examines each action produced by the generator along with the corresponding observation
self_verification.note: Assistant may use same model (force_same_LM 1) — self_critique-like in main experiments; feedback filtered by probability threshold 0.93.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The number of trials for Reflexion is set to 2.
retry_policy.note: Default rollback scripts single attempt; Reflexion variants give fixed_n trials.

rollback.evidence_quote: we retrieve the action setAt−1 = [a 1,...,a t−1] fromTt−1, reset the environment, and sequentially execute the actions inAt−1 to restore the state to that ofTt−1.
rollback.note: Rollback by environment reset + action replay; closest value snapshot.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: --max_roll_num 6 \    # the maximum num of rollbacks allowed (to prevent infinite loops)
termination_condition.note: Rollback cap; episode ends on environment done/step limit (not shown).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: --max_roll_num 6 \    # the maximum num of rollbacks allowed (to prevent infinite loops)
